purpose: Stress-test evidence routing outside the current five broad v1 families with carbohydrate-active enzymes that expose same-fold/different-mechanism, acid/base geometry, lyase/isomerase, carbohydrate esterase, and TIM-barrel collision failures.

external_metadata_scout.source: UniProtKB REST metadata scout on 2026-05-28; PDB identifiers recorded only, no coordinate downloads.

provenance_tier_definitions.tier_A_mcsa_curated: M-CSA/local curated mechanism and active-site row used as anchor/control only.
provenance_tier_definitions.tier_B_external_curated: External UniProt/PDB lead with reviewed entry, structure availability, and active-site/binding annotations sufficient for review-only routing design.
provenance_tier_definitions.tier_C_external_incomplete: External lead with useful structure/reaction context but missing one or more residue-role, duplicate, substrate-state, or terminal-review blockers.
provenance_tier_definitions.tier_D_control_only: Hard negative, sequence holdout, exact/near duplicate, non-carbohydrate TIM/esterase/isomerase, or other row that must never be imported as a glycoside positive.

rationale: The row mix is external-heavy enough for a first router validation design: 39 external UniProt/PDB leads and 21 M-CSA anchors/controls.
The local pilot already exposes the intended failure mode: Q6NSJ0 has a sourced acidic dyad and glycan pocket but heuristic routing collapsed to metal_dependent_hydrolase.

Sourcing is not too sparse for a no-decision validation manifest, but it is too sparse for label import because many external leads still need current-reference sequence screens, Foldseek screens, substrate-state inspection, and terminal review.

foldseek_success: Retaining/inverting glycoside hydrolases may find CAZy/TIM-barrel structural neighbors, but fold alone must not promote non-carbohydrate TIM barrels or carbohydrate esterases.
m_csa:428 should be reported as a caveated fold collision, not a clean glycosidase-positive structural proof; m_csa:440 should remain a near-orphan abstention diagnostic.
External lyase/isomerase/esterase hard negatives should either cluster with their own mechanism families or abstain; a generic metal/serine hydrolase or GH promotion is failure.
geometry_rescue: Retaining GH rescue requires two correctly role-assigned acidic residues in glycosidic C1 geometry: nucleophile plus acid/base or proton donor/acceptor.
Inverting GH rescue requires acid plus water-activating base geometry and should not require a covalent glycosyl-enzyme nucleophile.
Substrate-assisted GH18 chitinases must be rescued by acid/base plus N-acetyl substrate assistance rather than rejected for missing enzyme nucleophile.
Carbohydrate esterases must be separated by ester carbonyl/acyl-enzyme or Asp-nucleophile geometry, not by carbohydrate substrate words.
learned_representation_value_add: Adds value if it separates Q6NSJ0/P0DUB6/Q9H227 glycosidase leads from P60174/Q9BV20/P06744 TIM/isomerase controls when sequence/Foldseek is ambiguous.
Adds value if carbohydrate esterases group closer to serine/aspartate esterase controls than retaining glycosidases despite glycan substrate context.
Does not add value if it merely reproduces EC/name keywords or pulls all TIM-barrels together.
correct_abstention: Abstain on tier_C rows missing explicit residue-role evidence or current duplicate screens.
Abstain or reject exact/near sequence holdouts such as O15527 rather than treating them as external generalization positives.
Abstain on non-carbohydrate TIM barrels, glycosyltransferases, and metabolic isomerases if no supported non-v1 family route exists.
